title: Calm Build QA
eyebrow: Built and checked in Chromium (the engine behind Chrome and Edge) · ready for you to test · pull request 209 · issues #198 to #218

short.lead: Calm by default is built into the real app. On a wide screen the Focus Deck name and the centred 'Jot down a stray thought…' box stay at the top, with the side menu below them. The Board shows one tab at a time, each card shows its priority and due date, and a Task details panel opens beside the list. Every setting is a row that opens and closes, and there is a new Comfort group. Projects is unchanged, as you chose in option 1A ('keep Projects as it is today'). You test a copy of branch AjsAgent/calm-build with sample data, on your phone or computer, so your real tasks are not touched.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what to try and what you should see.
items: This is a copy of branch AjsAgent/calm-build with sample data. A site called raw.githack serves it from GitHub, so it opens on your phone or computer with nothing to install.

Open https://raw.githack.com/Ajw2003/focus-deck-app/22ba8b82e00a3336b788eedc58c9e10977fe1675/docs/generated/sort-steps/seed.html#board?ties in your browser. Change the end to #focus, #sort or #projects to open another screen. Opening the address again reloads the sample data, so it also works as a reset.

items.alt: The built Board at 1440 wide with sample data
items.caption: The Board you should see first.

items: Check the header and side menu
The name and jotter stay at the top while the page scrolls; the side menu sits below them with Settings and sync at its foot.
Scroll the Board down. Then type a thought into 'Jot down a stray thought…' and press Add; the Sort badge in the side menu goes up by one.
The list narrows as you type and filter, and 'Show 7 more' adds the next cards.
Type 'boiler' into Find. Clear it, press Filter and choose 'Has subtasks'. Clear the filter, then press 'Show 7 more (51 left)' under the list.
Task details opens beside the list with only one row open at a time, and changes save as you make them.

Click the 'Book boiler service' card. Open Subtasks and press '+ Add a subtask'. Change the status menu from Up next to In progress. Press the Escape key to close the panel. Then press '→ In progress' on another card; it should move to the In progress tab.

items.alt: Task details for Book boiler service with Subtasks open
items.caption: Task details with Subtasks open.

items: Change the card colour and late tasks

Each card shows one coloured label (a chip), taken from whichever item is first on the Card colour list. A task past its date shows amber 'past its date' by default, or red 'overdue' when you choose it.

Open Settings from the side menu. Under Comfort, open Card colour and press '↑ Up' on Priority, then press Back; the coloured labels on the Board now put Priority first. In Task details, give any task a due date in the past; its card should say 'past its date'. Then go to Settings and, under Comfort, set 'Tasks past their date' to Red; the same card should now say 'overdue'.

items.alt: A Board card showing 290d past its date in amber
items.caption: A late task on the Board, amber by default.

items: See priority and due date on cards
Every Board card with a priority, a due date or both shows them on one line under its coloured label (added after your first look).

On the Board, open a card's Task details, open 'Priority and due date', and set a priority and a due date 3 days away. Close the panel; the card should now show a flag with the priority word, then 'due in 3d'.

items.alt: A Board card showing Urgent and due in 3d under its Repair label
items.caption: The line on a card with a priority and a due date.

items: Check that a task due today is red and the yellow chip is easy to see
A task due today always shows red. The yellow 'due soon' chip now has a stronger olive fill and a solid border, so you can see it on a bright white screen (added after your second look).

On the Board, open 'Mop the kitchen' in Task details and give it today's date; its card should show a red label. Give 'Fix the gate latch' a date 3 days away; its 'due in 3d' chip should have a strong olive fill and a dark outline. Then switch your phone to dark mode: that chip should look the same, because Board cards stay paper-coloured in both modes.

items.alt: Board cards on a phone: Mop the kitchen with a red Due today label, Fix the gate latch with an olive due in 3d chip
items.caption: A red 'Due today' label and the stronger yellow chip.

items: Check that the Board follows the project you pick
With a project picked, the tab numbers count only that project's tasks, and the heading shows its name in its colour (added after your third look).

On the Board, pick Home from the Project menu. The heading should say 'Home' with a coloured dot and bar, the menu should have a border in the same colour, and Up next should count only Home's tasks. Type a word in Find, and the tab numbers should drop to match the list. Then pick 'Project: All'; the heading should go back to 'Board'.

items.alt: The Board on a phone with Home picked: heading Home with a green dot and bar, a green-edged menu, Up next 23
items.caption: The Board with Home picked.

items: A step you can't use yet says why, and right-clicking a project or label card opens its colour picker.

Open Sort. Before choosing a project, press '2. Stick on flags'; a line should say 'Choose a project first. Labels and links open once the thought has a project.' Then right-click a project card; its colour picker should open.
Below 1100 pixels wide, the bottom bar returns and Task details fills the screen.
Make the browser window narrow, or open the same address on your phone if it is on the same network as your computer, and repeat the 'Open and edit a task' step.
Your reply tells me whether the issues for this build, #198 to #208 and #210 to #218, can move forward.
Reply 'QA passed: calm by default', or say what's wrong.

unverified: I did not open the test copy's address from step 1 (on raw.githack), because my sandbox, the closed-off space I work in, can't reach that site
Changes made in Task details on a GitHub-linked task were checked by reading the code only, not with a live GitHub call
Everything was checked in Chromium only, not in Safari or Firefox and not on a real phone
One case in the category-filter check was dropped, because the labels step is now locked until a project is chosen, so a thought with no project can no longer reach the labels list
'Surprise me' was left unchanged, because the plan gave no new wording for it
The olive words on the yellow chip are a darker shade than the design showed (#3A4200 instead of #4F5A00), because the design's shade failed the 4.5:1 text contrast check on the stronger fill

wrapup.summary: Calm by default is built. The header and side menu stay in place, and the Board shows one tab at a time. You also get Task details, one coloured label per card, settings as rows that open and close, with a new Comfort group, plainer wording and the Sort fixes. Cards show their priority and due date too, in the new due colours (red for due today, a stronger olive for due soon), and the Board follows the project you pick. All 229 unit tests and all 13 browser checks pass.
wrapup.changing: Changed: the frame, the Board, Settings and some wording. New: Task details, Card colour and the Comfort group. Unchanged: Projects.
wrapup.next: After 'QA passed', you close the issues when you're happy, and the pull request is merged into main, the version of the app you use.
